RoyalTitleDef.label: Squire
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn attendant learning the duties of arms and service. The first honor earned in service to the Stormlands. Stormlander titles confer standing, not psychic powers, and never forbid honest work.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn knight recognized for courage, honorable conduct, and faithful service to the houses of the Stormlands.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Landed Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A knight recognized as worthy of a landed household and its duties. This honor grants standing, not a new settlement.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A recognized head of a Stormlands house, bound to protect its people and honor sworn obligations.

RoyalTitleDef.label: High Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A High Lord, also called a Great Lord, commands the respect of lesser houses and carries greater responsibility for the Stormlands.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord Paramount
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Stormlands' highest honor, recognizing exceptional leadership and service among its great Houses. It grants your House standing without replacing the Stormlands' ruler or transferring their lands.
